content: Gata dǝga sǝrga
Sarǝvsǝg nǝ Farisiyaha ard Sadukiyah da vak Yesu kiyava fishǝgaan kǝ iitǝra, kaa ghalgaan kǝ iitǝr ma martǝrdan kǝ dǝga sǝrǝg kwa da mara taakiya, sǝghhi vak Daadamazhigǝla.
Ngutǝrnaguga, amaa, “Akwama ɓǝlaaɓǝlǝg nǝ hwaasa, ma nǝghǝmanǝghǝg kǝ zhigǝla ba kyanga, am tagaan taakiya da maraw nǝ kǝs dlakaduura.

Akwama nǝghamanǝghǝg kǝ zhigǝl ba kyanga dlakaduur wur ciyitciig nǝ ghabaga, am tagaan taakiya, ‘Da hyiyav nǝ yuwa hiinanna.’ Am nǝghǝgaakanǝghǝg tsau kǝ ndzǝgana zhigǝla. Ɗǝmakurvaa ndar kaci nǝghǝgaaka ndzǝgan kwanǝn kǝ zamani?

Uudaha zamana ar maay dǝ jiir tǝvuukwa Daadamazhigǝl biya, dlaɓa ar kǝladaha. Ar nagan mara nǝgha kǝ dǝga sǝrga, da maay marvǝtǝrmarǝg nǝ watlǝrn kǝ dǝga sǝrǝg biya, bamma dǝga sǝrǝga Yunana.” Kaa ɗuutǝrsɗuug kǝ iin ngal dagalaana.
Yista Farisiyah ard Sadukiyaha
Daral ba nǝ mbǝrzahaan dat ghyaba kwah kǝ gardza yuwa haiya, mbats viyaatǝraviig nǝ kǝsa bruudiya.
Aiyam nǝ Yesu taa kǝ iitǝra, “Famfǝg kǝ hyǝmiya, dlaɓa am fǝgaan kǝ taaɗ tǝ yista Farisiyah ard Sadukiyaha.”
Kaa fagarzhafǝg kǝ iitǝr tagaan ma taatakatǝr taakiya, “Mbakyarvad kǝsyamant bi kǝ bruudi nii?”
Nǝghghaaka ba nǝ Yesu ǝndkwana, aiyama, “Kuuram lii hǝtsahǝtsan nǝ fadghǝra, aujilbǝg am taaki am maay dǝ bruudi biyi?
Mbats gwastǝn nǝghamaaka biya? Viiyakuraviig nǝ ɗuuli gǝlantǝrǝt nai kǝ uudah alfu dlǝɓ dǝ ɗummba bruudi dlǝɓa? Alghwa ngwɛn wa dzahamant nǝ uurami?
Nii ma sarta kwa gǝlantǝrǝt nai kǝ uudah alfu uufaɗ dǝ ɗummba bruudi uudifna, alghw ngwɛn wa dzahamant nǝ uurami?
Aujibǝg nǝghǝghaamaka bi taakiya ǝn tag tǝghǝr kǝ bruudi bi nai kǝ ǝlbǝgǝn biyi? Amaaya, famfǝg kǝ hǝnkal tǝ yista Farisiyaha ard Sadukiyaha.”

Tǝhalakwah wa nǝgharaaka nǝ mbǝrzahaan taakiya, tagtǝr taaki aa farfǝg kǝ hǝnkal tǝ yistin kwa ɗiiyav ma bruudiyin biya, mbats tagtǝr taakiya aa farfǝg kǝ hǝnkal dǝ tsagaana Farisiyaha ard Sadukiyaha.
Ɓagaaɓag nǝ Bitrus kǝ shiid taaki Yesu iin Kǝristi
Sǝghal ba nǝ Yesu damma larda Kaisariya Filibi, kaa ndavtǝrundavǝg kǝ iin kǝ mbǝrzahaana, amaa, “War nǝ Zǝra Uud mar tagaan nǝ uudahi?”
Aiyam nǝ iitǝra, “Kyalm ar taakiya Yuhwan dadda tsuufǝga, kyalmah ar taakiya, tlayanga Iliya, kyalmah dlaɓa ar taakiya Irimiya bi pal ma tlayangaha.”
Aiyama taa kǝ iitǝra, “Kuramǝm ǝn war nai mam tlǝg nǝ ghǝraruwi?”
Kaa ngwangug kǝ Siman Bitrusa taakiya, “Kǝgh nǝ Kǝristi, Zǝra Daadamazhigǝla kwa dǝ shifǝga.”
Aiyam nǝ Yesu taa kǝ iina, “Agha dǝ bark nǝng, Siman zǝra Yunana, aɗaba uud bi wa markada kwanǝn biya, aa markada nǝ Daadar ma ghǝrazhigǝla.

Ən tagaktaga, agha Bitrus nǝnga, agha band akur kwa ndǝra nǝ uudan kǝ hǝngah tǝ vakaiya, ǝn da ɓaatlǝr dǝ kǝgh nai kǝ fǝtǝrna ndzǝɗ kǝ yaa dadda gata kaiya, kwa da maay nǝ ǝmtsǝg dǝ ndzǝɗa tǝghǝr kǝ iitǝr biya.

Ən da vǝlakvǝlǝg kǝ dǝga wura tlǝksǝra ghǝrazhigǝla, dlaɓa badǝm nǝ dǝgiti agha ngwuɗǝgant nǝng ma duniya, da ngwuɗav ma ghǝrazhigǝla, baɗǝm dǝgiti agha pǝlnanǝng ma duniya, da pǝlav ma ghǝrazhigǝla.”
Ɓǝlatǝraaɓǝlǝg nǝ Yesu kǝ magyi kǝ mbǝrzahaan ba vaivai aa tagarar bi aanji ndǝwar taakiya kai nǝ Kǝristi biya.
Tagadatag Yesu tǝghǝr kǝ ǝmtsǝgaana

Ciigǝt ma kwahiin kǝ sart wa tagatǝr nǝ Yesu kǝ mbǝrzahaan taakiya, barari dagal damma Wurshalima, da hǝɓuu kǝ dlaɗa shahshaha, ma dǝv kǝ maalaha ard maala zhiila kǝssufah ard lii tsaga adzahadzaha, da tsǝvana, tǝ hǝng hǝkǝrɗa da ciivant dǝ shifǝga.
Ngal tǝɗant nǝ Bitrus damma dlǝmmbaava, cagaraa kǝ gyiya, amaa, “Aa tsanttsǝg nǝ Daadamazhigǝla, Yaazhigǝla, da dzǝgaar bi nǝ wan dǝ kǝgh ba dǝm biya.”
Kaa gwiyav nǝ Yesu da vak Bitrus, amaa, “Yagh vakar Shatanaha, agha akura mbǝɗa uud tǝ ɗuul nǝng vakara, agha dzamaghǝr band uuda dǝg shiga ndǝ Daadamazhigǝl biya.”
Aiyam nǝ Yesu taa kǝ mbǝrzahaana, “Baɗǝm dadda kwa na gata kaiya, bamma ɗugharsɗuug kǝ ghǝraana, kǝsant kǝ tlaɓa hǝrtǝgaana, gatǝkwagatǝga.
Aɗaba baɗǝm dadda kwa na kata shifǝgaana, da ɓǝgaan dagala, Badǝm nǝ daddakwa ɓǝlda shifǝgaan mbakyarvad kaiya da tlǝknatlǝga.
Au peɗaan kǝ uud akwama tlakǝnatlǝg kǝ duni baɗǝmma, tǝhalakwaha ɓǝldan kǝ shifǝgaani? Nii auwa da vǝlǝda nǝ uudan dlakulva shifǝgaani?
Zǝra Uuda da sii dǝ zǝrɓǝlgahaan ma ndangǝra Daddaana, da vǝlgarvǝlg kǝ dǝg shigaan aanji war kalkala dǝgiti ɓagaa nǝ iina.
Ən takurtaga, mǝng nǝ kyalma uudahi ghaciga vakwanǝnna ar da maay ǝmtsǝg biya bamma nǝghǝgharanghǝg kǝ saay Zǝra Uuda ma tlǝkǝsǝraana.”
